title: Research at no, partial and full overlap shows whether a shared coord store cuts duplicate facts or tokens beyond the spread
goal: multi has research scenarios at no overlap (three distinct areas, e.g. pip, rust, sops) and partial overlap (e.g. pip, uv, python) beside the full-overlap research scenario (pip three times), each runnable with coord=shared and coord=isolated; a paid run within the operator's spend cap records as many records per arm and level as the spend gate sized, and the report and token-efficiency.md (Concurrent agents) state per overlap level dup_facts, dedup_hits and tokens and USD per verified fact as ranges, and whether shared differs from isolated beyond the spread at each level

gates.question: What is the spend cap for the paid graded-overlap runs (all levels, both arms, all records)?
options: size from a dry-run plan first
gates.reason: the operator's choice when the story was filed

notes: Premise: python3 _tools/rag.py show kb/_self/token-efficiency.md:152 -n 1 shows record 00cb019, two records per arm, shared and isolated token ranges overlapping and dup_facts not lower under shared. kb/_self/reports/multi_bench.csv already runs research at full overlap (research-1..3 all on pip) and coord at partial (pip, uv), so overlap alone was not missing: the levels and the records per arm are. Areas must be bench_repro briefs (pip, uv, python, rust, sops and the rest of load_briefs). Model and records per arm are sized under the spend gate; Haiku research ran at about 3.40-6.21 USD per record, the Sonnet research dry run estimates 8.48 USD per scenario run.
